name: Health
overview: Scripture reveals that true health is deeply connected to obedience and reverence toward the LORD, who promises healing and protection from disease when His commandments are followed (Exodus 15:26; 23:25). Both physical and mental well-being are nurtured by God's care, as He heals the brokenhearted and restores the soul (Psalms 147:3). Wisdom in fearing the LORD and avoiding evil supports health, while positive speech and a joyful heart contribute to the body's strength and vitality (Proverbs 3:7; 16:24; 17:22). This holistic view underscores that health encompasses spiritual, mental, and physical dimensions grounded in a Christ-centered life.
